name: issue_1208_return_home_mild_day_restores_comfort
description: Issue #1208 (fixed, mild-day sibling): mild day (classifier derives hvac_mode=off), indoor next to the comfort floor. The occupant leaves, the away setback is held, and on returning at 14:00 the thermostat is told the comfort FLOOR (heat, 70F) on arrival, not up to 30 minutes later.
notes: Regression scenario for Issue #1208 (fixed, owner-approved for golden 2026-11-02), heating family: the comfort-edge selector arms heat next to the floor on a mild day.
Occupant outcome: the occupant comes home on a cool mild afternoon and the thermostat gets the 70F comfort heat setpoint at once instead of holding the away setback.
(a) Scenario effectiveness: with the band-derived mode reverted, the 14:00 comfort_restored (70F) assertion fails; this scenario reported EXPECTED FAIL before the fix.

(b) Docs <-> production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md (E10) and docs/occupancy-dispatch-spec.md step 3 state that the restore family comes from the resolved comfort band, which is what production does.
(c) User outcome if this regresses: on mild days the occupant returns to a cold house for up to 30 minutes while the push says comfort is being restored.

events.note: morning classification — mild day, label off, comfort band armed
indoor sits next to the 70F comfort floor
user leaves home - away setback applied after the delay
30-min classification cycle fires while away — must NOT overwrite setback with comfort
another classification cycle — should still maintain setback
still next to the comfort floor on arrival
user returns next to the floor - comfort heat (70F) restored on arrival

assertions.reason: initial classification at home - mild day, label off, comfort band armed
classification while away — setback reapplied (80F), comfort NOT restored
another classification while away — setback maintained (80F)
occupancy_change to home — comfort_heat (70F, the floor the house is next to) restored
Issue #1208: by the 14:30 cycle the occupant is home, so the armed band floor must equal comfort_heat (70F), not the 60F away setback.

verdict.summary: Issue #1208: returning home on a mild day restores the comfort floor on arrival
verdict.observed_behavior: comfort_restored (70F heat) at 14:00; armed band floor 70F at 14:30
verdict.expected_behavior: comfort_restored (70F heat) at 14:00, and the armed band floor equals comfort_heat (70F) at 14:30
